verdict.rationale: The API reference introduction explicitly offers a download of the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec, alongside documented endpoints, auth, rate limits and errors. The probe's 404s only covered guessed paths on docs.incident.io, so they do not contradict the documented download, but they do lower confidence. Missing for 10: a verified, resolvable spec URL; independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and is complete.
